comments.author: Dongwoo
comments.body: Does anybody know if I can run two of these chains in parallel? Or is running one of them blocking the quests of the others? I've started the adv chain, some nice discos there, but I won't have that appr unl 14 12 for the last one in the foreseeable future :-). So I was thinking of going to do the merch chain instead / in parallel to get the title quicker.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Hey, does anybody know if it's possible to play through all three chains? Like, you do the adventure one first, then go back later and play the merchant and maritime chains, too. (Yeah, I'm one of those crazy completionist-types.)

comments.author: Snipe
comments.body:
To completely complete all chains, I'm not sure, but its possible to play all three chains, starting from the first quest. I mean, if a trader completed the trade chain and got the title, the adv chain could still be done and the discoveries obtained. If not how would the trader ever get the discoveries if he/she ever wants to turn adv?

But still, I'm not sure if this quest could be taken more than once.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: Thanks for the answer! I think I have a plan of action now: do every quest in every chain, saving this one for very last. Hopefully, I should be able to see every cutscene that way. Good gaming to you!
